name: ROOK ANSELM
bio: A Dusk Quarter shipwright born under the open Seam, shifted so heavy he sank the first boat he built. He became the keel of the resistance instead: a wall of borrowed mass along the river that the Unspooled have never crossed. Ninety days on his feet.
catchphrase: Your strand had eleven seconds. Ours is still counting.

theme.tagline: Built the wall. Stood on it.
